title: GTA 6 Pre-Load Date, Release Time & Physical Map Confirmed
description: Rockstar Games has officially confirmed the GTA 6 pre-load schedule, install size, and release details. Pre-loading begins November 10 for digital editions, with a 212 GB install size required. The game will release at midnight local time on November 19, and a physical map will be included.
youtubeTitle: GTA 6 Pre-Load Date Confirmed: November 10, 212 GB Install
socialHook: GTA 6 pre-loading starts November 10 with a 212 GB install size.

sections.heading: Pre-Load Schedule and 212 GB Install Size
paragraphs: Rockstar Games has announced the pre-load schedule for Grand Theft Auto VI, as reported by RockstarINTEL. Digital pre-loading for PlayStation 5 will begin on Tuesday, November 10 at midnight local time in each time zone. For Xbox Series X|S, pre-loading starts globally on the same day at 12 a.m. GMT. The studio also confirmed the game's install size: 212 GB, which is nearly double that of Red Dead Redemption 2. This information was corroborated by Kotaku and GamesRadar, who cited the official announcement.

sections.heading: Global Release Time and Physical Map Confirmation
paragraphs: Rockstar Games has confirmed that GTA 6 will launch at midnight local time worldwide on November 19, 2026, meaning players in New Zealand will gain access earlier than those in the Americas. For physical edition buyers, code-in-box versions will be available from retailers starting November 12 for both PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Additionally, a physical map of Leonida will be included with certain editions, as reported by RockstarINTEL and covered by multiple outlets.

sections.heading: Free Digital Poster and Map for Leonida
paragraphs: On November 19, Rockstar Games will add an official printable Grand Theft Auto VI cover art poster and a map of Leonida as free digital downloads on the official website. A double-sided physical version of this poster will be available shortly after launch from the Rockstar Store for $0.99 or as a free gift with any store purchase. These details were first reported by RockstarINTEL and align with the studio's announcement.
